# **RELAX, FLOW, PLAY** 
# Enter SQUINGLE ARCADE, the ultimate free-to-play cosmic arcade-puzzle!

Guide twin revolving orbs through  glass-like 3D mazes that twist, turn, and pulse with life. Defeat hypnotic enemies, find secret paths, and collect every color orb.
[media]
[media]
[media]

**Dive into the highest-rated VR puzzle universe!** Squingle Arcade takes the critically acclaimed original and supercharges it with high-stakes arcade action.

Inspired by the precision of classics like Kururin and the visual splendor of Tetris Effect, Squingle Arcade is a multisensory journey through cosmic transcendence.

# KEY FEATURES

• **Mind-Bending Levels:** Navigate increasingly complex Squingles, morphing sculptures that challenge your spatial awareness and manual dexterity.

• **Competitive Arcade Mode:** Race in a true asynchronous multiplayer mode against other players and reach the top of the leaderboards.
[media]
• **Relax or Rush:** Play at your own pace in a meditative Flow state or tackle Challenge Mode for an intense time-trial experience.

• **Optional Mixed Reality Immersion:** Watch as cosmic structures emanate from your real-world walls.
[media]
• **Optional Hand Tracking:** Use your hands to guide the orbs with fluid, natural movements, or stick with Touch controllers for haptic-enhanced precision.

• **Room-Scale & Sitting Support:** Play at any scale, from a miniature desk-sized maze to a room-filling cosmic structure that engages your whole body.


# Join our Discord to be part of the community and keep up with the news:
https://discord.com/invite/yUf7TwZ7Me
